Plain-language policy

Privacy

Effective October 10, 2026

For grown-ups: Acornoodle Books is made for families, but this website is intended to be used and managed by adults.

What this site collects

This site does not provide accounts, comments, contests, uploads, newsletters, contact forms, or direct purchases. We do not intentionally ask children—or anyone else—to submit personal information through this website.

Basic technical information

Our hosting and font providers may receive standard technical requests needed to deliver and secure the site, such as an IP address, browser type, requested page, and date or time. We have not configured advertising pixels, behavioral advertising, or optional audience analytics.

Children’s privacy

Children should not send names, addresses, photographs, school information, or other personal details through this site. If an adult believes a child’s information has reached us, please use the Support page so we can address it.

Retailer links

When a purchase link is added, it may lead to an independent retailer such as Amazon. That retailer’s privacy practices and terms will apply on its website.

Contact

Visit Support. A monitored adult support address will be published before this site is opened to the public.

This is a practical working policy for the site’s current, collection-free design and is not a substitute for legal advice.
